description: A panoramic photograph captures a wide, natural landscape under a clear blue sky. In the foreground, a broad, light-coloured sandy bank or dry riverbed is visible. In the mid-ground, a calm body of water, likely a river or wide stream, flows. Both banks of the water body are densely covered with vibrant green bushy vegetation, consistent with riparian scrub or reeds. A multi-span, light-beige coloured bridge crosses the river. In the background, arid, rocky hills rise on both sides. On the slopes of the prominent hill on the right side, several buildings are visible, including a large complex of white and light-coloured structures, possibly a resort or hotel, with dark panels (potentially solar panels) on the hillside. The landscape illustrates contrasting land cover types: dense riparian vegetation in the river valley and sparse vegetation on the dry, mountainous terrain.
